main_measure.name: 6-bar return after top-decile forecast bars minus after neutral RSI (45-55) bars
main_measure.threshold: difference > 0 with t >= 2 to confirm; difference < 0 with t <= -2 to reject

supporting_check.name: coins with positive top-decile excess over unconditional 6-bar mean

decided_by: The t-statistic lies strictly between -2 and 2, so the plan rules the test inconclusive.
reading: Top decile is forecast >= the 90th percentile of all forecast values pooled over coins and windows (and > 0), cases and the unconditional mean use the non-overlapping 6-bar grid from each window's first row, neutral is raw value in [-2, 2] inclusive, and with only 2 coins in the record the '2 of 3 coins' rule requires both coins positive.
